title: Run HO19 / Winflo Shield man running

location.series: Annie Nguyen / Nike Run Core Holiday 2019

slide_intent: Test a repeated layout with different subjects so consistency survives changes in photography.
strategic_value: A stable text column and inset position can link the male and female Winflo executions without making their photographs identical.
demonstration: A man in gray running clothes fills the main photograph; a stair-side shoe inset sits at upper right, crossing the same white outline Swoosh used in NS12.
practical_value: Compare subject placement and cropping against NS12 before reusing the composition.

content_islands.name: Text area
content_islands.spec: Keep the low-aligned product heading, supporting line and black Swoosh inside the white left column.

content_islands.name: Runner
content_islands.spec: Use the full stride against the railing as the central image.

content_islands.name: Inset and outline
content_islands.spec: Place the footwear close-up at upper right and span the two images with the white outline Swoosh.
